numerical_claims.source_value: Own work capitalized DKK 5,190k (2025) vs DKK 3,621k (2024)
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Income statement note 1: 'Own work capitalized Staff costs classified as assets 5,190 (2025) vs 3,621 (2024).' Financial review: 'Activation of development costs of DKK 5.2M in 2025 had a positive impact on EBITDA. This is an increase from DKK 3.6M in 2024.'

numerical_claims.claim: Net loss for the year was DKK 6.8M, compared with DKK 11.4M in 2024
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: Profit/loss for the period DKK −6,835k (2025) vs DKK −11,447k (2024)
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Income statement: Profit/loss for the period 2025 DKK −6,835k, 2024 DKK −11,447k. Financial review references the improvement from DKK 11.4M loss to DKK 6.8M loss.

numerical_claims.claim: ARR reached DKK 46.2M at year-end, up 19% from DKK 38.7M in 2024 and at the upper end of the revised guidance range
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Financial highlights: 'At the end of 2025, Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) amounted to DKK 46.2M, corresponding to a 19% year-on-year growth rate... in line with our preliminary released 2025 ARR.' Management commentary confirms ARR at upper end of revised guidance range DKK 43M–46M.

numerical_claims.claim: Net new ARR was DKK 7.5M for the full year, below DKK 8.3M in 2024, but second-half momentum strengthened considerably, with fourth-quarter net new ARR rising to DKK 3.1M from DKK 1.8M in the corresponding quarter
numerical_claims.candidate_value: Net new ARR DKK 7.5M (2025) vs DKK 8.3M (2024); Q4 net new ARR DKK 3.1M (2025) vs DKK 1.8M (2024)
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: Net new ARR DKK 7.5M (2025) vs DKK 8.3M (2024); Q4 net new ARR DKK 3.1M (2025) vs DKK 1.8M (2024)
numerical_claims.source_evidence: ARR development and SaaS metrics: 'For the full year 2025, Impero’s net new ARR was DKK 7.5M compared to net new ARR of DKK 8.3M in the full year 2024... We ended the year with a strong Q4 2025, with net new ARR of DKK 3.1M, compared to DKK 1.8M in the corresponding quarter in 2024.'

numerical_claims.claim: Churn was only 1%, compared with 2% in 2024, while net revenue retention was 106%, down slightly from 108%
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: ARR development and SaaS metrics: 'In 2025, we had an exceptionally low churn rate of only 1%... Net Revenue Retention Rate (NRR) ended at 106% in 2025, slightly lower than 108% in 2024.'

numerical_claims.claim: Average ARR per account increased 8% to DKK 228T, supported by a 12% gross uplift from existing customers
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: ARPA DKK 228T (2025) vs DKK 212T (2024); gross uplift 12%
numerical_claims.source_evidence: ARR development and SaaS metrics table: ARPA 2025 DKK 228T, 2024 DKK 212T. Text: 'We lifted the Average ARR per Account (ARPA) to a record high level of DKK 228T by the end of 2025... gross uplift of 12%.' The 8% increase is calculated as (228−212)/212 ≈ 7.5%, rounded to 8% in the summary.

numerical_claims.claim: Growth was led by Denmark and the DACH region, where ARR increased 22% and 26%, respectively
numerical_claims.candidate_value: Denmark ARR +22% YoY; DACH ARR +26% YoY
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: Denmark ARR +22% YoY; DACH ARR +26% YoY
numerical_claims.source_evidence: ARR development and SaaS metrics: 'In Denmark, we increased net new ARR by a growth rate of 22% YoY... Our second core market, the DACH region, led the growth with 26% growth YoY in 2025.'

numerical_claims.claim: Each region represented approximately 44% of total ARR at year-end
numerical_claims.candidate_value: Denmark and DACH each ~44% of total ARR
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: Denmark 44% of total ARR; DACH 44% of total ARR
numerical_claims.source_evidence: ARR development and SaaS metrics: 'In Denmark... the Danish market now constitutes 44% of Impero’s total ARR... the DACH region closed the year with a total ARR of DKK 20.1M, corresponding to 44% of Impero’s total ARR.'

numerical_claims.claim: The company surpassed 200 customers after adding 26 during the year, while top-10 customer concentration declined to 20% from 24%
numerical_claims.candidate_value: >200 customers (2025); new customers added 26; top-10 concentration 20% (2025) vs 24% (2024)
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: Customer base >200; new customers 26; top-10 concentration 20% (2025) vs 24% (2024)
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Management commentary: 'By the end of 2025, we reached a significant milestone as our customer base surpassed 200 customers... welcomed 26 new customers... top 10 customer concentration measured on ARR has decreased from 37% to 20% as of year-end 2025.' Earlier reports confirm 24% at end of 2024.

numerical_claims.claim: Cash flow from ordinary operating activities was negative DKK 1.3M, compared with negative DKK 4.3M in 2024, although DKK 5.6M was invested in intangible assets
numerical_claims.candidate_value: Operating cash flow: DKK 1.3M loss (2025) vs DKK 4.3M loss (2024); intangible asset additions DKK 5.6M (2025)
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: Operating cash flow: DKK 1,396k loss (2025) vs DKK 4,046k loss (2024); intangible asset additions DKK 5,377k (2025)
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Cash flow statement: Cash flow from operating activities 2025 DKK −1,396k, 2024 DKK −4,046k. Investing activities: Additions of intangible assets 2025 DKK −5,377k, 2024 DKK −3,603k. Summary section states 'cash flow from ordinary operating activities was negative DKK 1.3M compared to negative DKK 4.3M in 2024... DKK 5.6M was invested in intangible assets.'

numerical_claims.claim: A DKK 15M directed issue in December helped increase year-end cash to DKK 18.9M and equity to DKK 15.4M
numerical_claims.candidate_value: Directed issue DKK 15M; year-end cash DKK 18.9M; equity DKK 15.4M
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: Directed issue DKK 15M; cash end DKK 18,851k (~18.9M); equity end DKK 15,413k (~15.4M)
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Cash flow statement: Cash flow from financing activities 2025 DKK 16,089k, primarily 'increase of capital' of DKK 16,089k (DKK 15M directed issue plus warrant exercises). Balance sheet: Cash 2025 DKK 18,851k, Equity 2025 DKK 15,413k. Financial review: 'We ended 2025 with a cash position of DKK 18.9M... equity stood at DKK 15.4M.'

numerical_claims.claim: For 2026, the company expects ARR of DKK 53M–57M and EBITDA between negative DKK 2M and positive DKK 1M
numerical_claims.candidate_value: ARR guidance DKK 53M–57M; EBITDA guidance DKK −2M to DKK +1M
numerical_claims.label: INCORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: ARR guidance DKK 53M–57M; EBITDA guidance DKK −2M to DKK −1M
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Guidance for 2026: 'By the end of 2026, Impero expects Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) to reach between DKK 53M and 57M... For 2026, EBITDA is expected to be in the range of DKK −2M to −1M due to our planned acceleration of commercial investments.'
numerical_claims.error_explanation: The candidate incorrectly states the EBITDA upper bound as positive DKK 1M, whereas the source explicitly states a range of negative DKK 2M to negative DKK 1M. This misrepresents the expected loss magnitude and direction.
